title: Digi International Unveils Digi XBee LR Module for LoRaWAN Connectivity for IoT Deployments
summary: This new addition to the Digi XBee Family of wireless modules, with complete device-to-cloud capabilities, brings LoRaWAN connectivity to the powerful Digi XBee ecosystem with over 20 million deployed devices
